newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil, gasoline shed gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil, gasoline shed gains.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday, with gas oil and gasoline shedding early gains but fuel oil barges ending stronger, traders said.
Spot gas oil markets shed morning gains as benchmark IPE gas oil futures were dragged lower by sharply weaker crude.
A strong dollar versus the mark kept demand from the German market quiet though inland refiners reported good business.
Balance of July heating oil barges for Rotterdam refinery lifting were traded around Aug IPE +$1.75 a tonne contract with storage material around 50 cents cheaper.
Dealers said premiums were slightly weaker than this in the afternoon with the supply tightness easing.
Gasoline went up in the morning and came down in the afternoon on news Iraq was a step closer to resuming oil exports. Prices were steady with cif cargoes around $199.

High sulphur fuel oil barges gained some $1, trading at $87.25/$87.50 fob ARA, with traders saying the physical market tracked higher swaps and crude's gain earlier. Low sulphur barges were largely steady, with a small deal at $95 fob.

High sulphur fuel cargoes were a mixed house, with some traders saying that talk was stronger on the back on the strength in barges but others saying they were steady with no firm bids higher than $82 cif. --London newsroom, +44 171 542 8145
